verdict.rationale: Three.js does ship an official web-based 'three.js editor' (viewport-like tool) and TransformControls for scene manipulation, but this is a separate, lightly-documented side tool, not the library's primary workflow — the core product is a code-first API. missing for 10: evidence of an inspector/property panel, prefab or scene-composition system, integration between editor and main workflow, and any hands-on confirmation that technical artists use the editor as their primary level-building tool.
